title: [SEC1] Centralize environment variable documentation
description:
Risk: Environment variables documented in 4 places with no consistency enforcement:
  - crates/kithd/src/config.rs (struct field comments)
  - contrib/README.md (environment variables table, lines 118-129)
  - contrib/systemd/kithd.service (lines 19-36)
  - contrib/systemd/kithd@.service (lines 26-47)

If a developer adds KITHD_NEW_VAR but forgets one of the four locations, drift occurs silently.

Maintainer burden: Manual review of every config change; easy to miss in refactors.

Mitigation: Generate README.md and/or systemd unit ENV tables from config.rs documentation via build script or pre-commit hook. Or consolidate all env var documentation into a single file and include it (via #[doc = include_str!()] or comments) in all 4 places.
